typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT COUNT(*) as CNT FROM dbo.BATCH',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource11
OLEDBSource11 derive(END_FILE = 'end') ~> DerivedColumn11
DerivedColumn11 sink(input(
		END_FILE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		END_FILE)) ~> FlatFileDestination11
